Retains immutable public factual observations, source checks, comparison snapshots,
URLs, hashes and review records under `data/verification`. The archive branch is
the public factual baseline for the next independent run while this PR awaits review.
Current source responses are transient/private; no full-page plaintext or ciphertext
is added by normal recurring verification. No evidence key or restored pages are needed.

Each observation retains its actual check time and observed source metadata.
An unchanged check references the exact factual approval, actual reviewer and review
time; it does not claim the reviewer personally re-read the source on the new check date.
First, changed and unapproved baselines still require official-source review.

No endorsement ledger, source panel, scoring, release, or production change is
approved by these observations. Review source changes through the finite daily
verification tasks. Baseline attestations and manual verification records must
receive normal repository review. This workflow does not queue auto-merge.
Fixture runs, operator dispatches and no-due successes do not establish adoption.

Refs #497
